_notes.budget: AutoML4Clust's native budget is the optimizer iteration count (n_loops -> SMAC runcount-limit). time_budget_sec is recorded for provenance/fairness alignment with ClustOpt's 120s philosophy but is NOT wall-clock enforced unless enforce_wallclock_timeout=true (best-effort thread timeout).
_notes.k_range: null = AutoML4Clust default [2, n/10], clamped for tiny datasets.
_notes.algorithms: null = AutoML4Clust default 4 k-center algorithms (KMeans, GMM, KMedoids, MBKMeans).
_notes.fairness: AutoML4Clust receives only the partition space. No true labels, no true K, no metric utilities, no family metadata.
